How to Reach

Our celebrations will be held at Maghdham Grande Resort in Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh. We have arranged private vehicles to bring you to the venue on your arrival.

Venue

Maghdham Grande Resort, Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh

By Air

Fly into Raja Bhoj Airport, Bhopal

By Train

Arrive at Vidisha Railway Station

Pickup

Private vehicles from Bhopal Airport and Vidisha Railway Station on arrival
